# CLI

- Import only `dart:` libraries, `package:dowel` and files under `lib/src/cli/`: `lib/cli.dart` reaches every file here and is loaded by dowel's Flutter-free dispatcher, so one Flutter or `package:magic` import breaks every command.
- In `InstallCommand`, stage transactional `installer.writeFile` ops first and helper-backed mutations (provider, Android permission, Info.plist key, `main.dart` wiring, web head script) last: helpers write synchronously while staging and do not roll back, so they must trail every write the atomic `.tmp` swap can undo. The APNs entitlements are written after a successful commit, never staged, because staging would make the command block its own `setEntitlementsPaths` split; `--dry-run` therefore does not list them.
- Read and match the `lib/config/notifications.dart` getter and the `main.dart` wiring only through `NotificationsConfigWiring`: detect existing wiring by the `config/notifications.dart` import, never by a symbol name, because a project whose getter is `notificationsConfig` got a second factory naming a symbol that does not exist on every re-run. Guard the web head script with `HtmlEditor.hasContent`, since the manifest's head-script dispatcher has no such check.
- A `--force` install that replaces an existing config realigns `main.dart` after the commit (`_realignMainFactory`), so it reads the config that actually landed and never fires on a dry run or a rolled-back transaction.
- Expose only read-only commands as MCP tools (`notifications_doctor` and `notifications_channels` in `mcpTools()`): install, configure, test, uninstall and publish write to the host project, so an agent must not trigger them over MCP.
